answer: First, each new identity pays an 80-unit genesis tax, non-refundable, under a 3-epoch watch. quill registration binds the receipt to one hash, so one payment cannot spawn two identities. Then, honest epochs rebate 15 units each, clearing the balance after 10 clean epochs; the kernel ledger blocks transfers. Finally, forgery forfeits the rest and freezes 8 epochs. 1,000 zephyr-fast clones pay 80,000 up front, and a 30% catch rate burns 24,000.
